$comment: Role definitions for the Remi pipeline. Applied by scripts/apply-roles.mjs.
codeMode is false for every worker: they have small catalogs and cheap models,
and OpenClaw's own guidance is to keep direct tool exposure in exactly that case.
Only the orchestrator needs codeMode, because it writes the pipeline scripts.
Reviewers run on DeepSeek on purpose. A reviewer sharing the author's training
distribution shares its blind spots. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the auth store.
projectAccess controls what the sandbox mounts:
none  no project bind at all. The role works from its task text.
ro    project mounted read-only. Reviewers and the planner.
rw    project mounted writable. Only the roles that must change files.
The bind uses the identical host path inside the container so that a cited
relative path means the same thing on both sides, and D10 validation holds.
